description: Use for a feed of what New Runtime published in the last 1-14 days, optionally on one topic: Field Notes (one per news story), Signals (syntheses of 2+ notes), analyses and weekly knowledge updates, with title, date, URL and a one-line why. Balanced by default (every day and kind get a turn); order "newest" is strictly by time. Up to 40 per call; pass next_offset as offset for more. Free, no auth. Example: {"days": 7, "topic": "coding-agents", "kinds": ["post", "signal", "analysis"]}. For what changed against what you already knew, use what_changed.

kinds.description: Default all. post = Field Note, signal = synthesis.

topic.description: Topic slug or name, or a system (openclaw, hermes).

name: whats_new

url.description: newruntime.com page; pass it to get_record.

why.description: One line on why the item matters.

next_offset.description: Pass as offset for the next page; null on the last.

title: What is new on New Runtime
